original_ai_output.title_zh: 拉各斯选举辩论：反对派候选人批评政府应对交通、洪水和住房问题不力
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 尼日利亚拉各斯州反对派州长候选人在2026年选举辩论中指责历届政府未能解决交通拥堵、洪水、住房负担不起和生活成本上涨等结构性问题。其中一名候选人声称既得利益集团阻碍了公共交通改革。执政党全体进步大会党候选人则为政府政绩辩护。

key_facts.fact: 拉各斯州反对派州长候选人指责历届政府未解决交通、洪水、住房等结构性问题
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Opposition governorship candidates in Lagos State have accused successive administrations of failing to address the structural problems behind traffic congestion, flooding, unaffordable housing and the rising cost of living

key_facts.fact: 一名候选人声称既得利益集团阻碍了公共交通改革
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: with one alleging that vested interests have frustrated efforts to reform public transportation

key_facts.fact: 辩论由2026辩论联盟主办，该联盟由PUNCH、Channels TV、TVC、The Cable和Vanguard组成
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: the 2026 series of election debates being hosted by the 2026 Debate Consortium, a partnership of PUNCH Nigeria Limited, Channels TV, TVC, The Cable and Vanguard Newspaper

key_facts.fact: 全体进步大会党候选人Obafemi Hamzat为政府政绩辩护
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: the All Progressives Congress candidate, Obafemi Hamzat, defended its record and outlined areas for further intervention

uncertainties: 相关指控为反对派候选人在辩论中的说法，尚未获得独立证实
目前仅单一来源（Punch）报道，尚缺乏交叉验证
